components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Contact-form submit: cyan-teal gradient with shimmer sweep and glow on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: linear-gradient(to right, #06b6d4, #14b8a6); color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px 32px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease, background 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-primary::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; left: -100%; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.2), transparent); transition: left 0.5s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(to right, #22d3ee, #2dd4bf); transform: scale(1.02); box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.4); } .ds-btn-primary:hover::before { left: 100%; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.3); }

components.name: Pill CTA
components.description: Capsule secondary CTA ('View all projects') with slate gradient and cyan hover overlay.
components.css: .ds-btn-pill { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; overflow: hidden; background: linear-gradient(to right, #1e293b, #334155); border: 1px solid #475569; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 32px; color: #f1f5f9; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-pill::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; background: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(6,182,212,0.12), rgba(20,184,166,0.12)); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-pill:hover { border-color: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.4); } .ds-btn-pill:hover::before { opacity: 1; } .ds-btn-pill-arrow { display: inline-block; animation: ds-nudge 1.5s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-nudge { 0%, 100% { transform: translateX(0); } 50% { transform: translateX(4px); } }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Card 'Code' action: quiet slate ghost that tints cyan on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.5); border: 1px solid rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.5); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; color: #cbd5e1; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost svg { color: #94a3b8; transition: color 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.4); background: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.1); color: #fff; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover svg { color: #22d3ee; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.3); }

components.html: Demo

Portal Bosque

components.css: .ds-card-glass { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.7) 0%, rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.5) 100%); border: 1px solid rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.15); border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px 24px; backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-card-glass:hover { border-color: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.4); box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.15), 0 0 0 1px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.1); transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-card-glass-title { margin: 0; color: #fff; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; transition: color 0.3s ease; } .ds-card-glass:hover .ds-card-glass-title { color: #67e8f9; } .ds-card-glass-body { margin: 0; color: #94a3b8; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.625; text-align: center; }

components.css: .ds-chip-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; justify-content: center; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-chip { background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.8); border: 1px solid rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.5); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 12px; color: #cbd5e1; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; transition: all 0.3s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.3); color: #67e8f9; }

components.name: Floating Label Input

components.css: .ds-input-field { position: relative; width: 100%; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.5); border: 1px solid rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.5); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; color: #f1f5f9; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.5); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.2); } .ds-input-label { position: absolute; left: 16px; top: 16px; color: #64748b; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; pointer-events: none; transition: all 0.3s ease; } .ds-input:focus + .ds-input-label, .ds-input:not(:placeholder-shown) + .ds-input-label { top: -8px; background: #0f172a; padding: 0 8px; color: #22d3ee; font-size: 0.75rem; }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.4); border: 1px solid rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.5); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 32px; backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); } .ds-nav-logo { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #06b6d4, #0d9488); color: #020617; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-nav-link { color: #cbd5e1; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #fff; transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-nav-divider { width: 1px; height: 16px; background: #334155; } .ds-nav-social { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); color: #cbd5e1; transition: all 0.3s ease; } .ds-nav-social:hover { border-color: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.5); background: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.2); color: #22d3ee; }

narrative.overview:
The site reads as a research station sunk into dark water: everything beyond the glass is deep navy void, and everything worth noticing arrives as light. Calm, precise, luminous. Color behaves like sonar — a single cyan family sweeping across slate depths, marking what is interactive or important, while teal rides as the warm undercurrent that keeps the space from feeling clinical. Surfaces are instruments: translucent glass panels with hairline cyan borders, quiet at rest, brightening when touched.

Density is deliberate and spacious. Sections float as full-width stages with one focal composition each; content gathers into narrow glass containers rather than filling the frame. Motion is the observatory's pulse, never decoration: elements surface with slow fade-up reveals, ambient orbs drift and breathe behind the glass, and interaction answers with lift and glow. The personality is welcoming without chasing — light signals that reward attention, in line with a professional who is open to offers rather than chasing them.
keyCharacteristics: Dark navy depth (#020617 → #0f172a diagonal gradient) as the permanent field — no light mode, no pure black.
One signal family: cyan and teal only; slate neutrals carry everything else.
Glassmorphism as the surface language: translucent panels, backdrop-blur, hairline cyan borders.
Glow as the elevation vocabulary: ambient on focal elements at rest, interactive lift + glow on state.
Slow, deliberate motion: 0.5–0.8s fade-up reveals, drifting ambient orbs, gradient text that shifts like light through water.
Capsule geometry for navigation and actions; soft 12–16px radii for content containers.

rules.name: The Sonar Rule
rules.body: Cyan is signal, not decoration. It marks what is interactive, focused, or important; on any given screen it should occupy a small minority of the pixels. If everything glows, nothing does.

rules.name: The Two-Current Rule
rules.body: Hue lives only in the cyan→teal current and the slate depths. The single exception is error red; no other hue family enters the system.

rules.name: The Abyss Floor Rule
rules.body: The darkest value in play is Abyss Navy (#020617). Pure black (#000000) backgrounds never appear — the depth is navy water, not a void.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Inter alone carries every level of the hierarchy today; differentiate by weight and size, not by font mixing. Introducing Space Grotesk as the display face is an open decision, never a silent drift.

rules.name: The Single Glowing Word Rule
rules.body: Gradient text appears once per section at most — a single word in a headline, or the hero name. It is a beacon, not a highlighter.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest as quiet glass. Glow and lift appear as a response to state — hover, focus, success — with ambient glow reserved for designated focal elements (hero orbs, profile ring) only.

rules.name: The Cyan Glow Rule
rules.body: Every glow in the system is the cyan family at 10–50% alpha. Never white glow, never gray/black drop shadows for elevation.

rules.name: The Capsule Rule
rules.body: Actions and navigation are capsules (fully rounded); content containers are soft rectangles (12–16px). The two never swap.

rules.name: The Gradient Text Is a Beacon Rule
rules.body: Reserve it for the hero name and one word per section headline. Body copy never shimmers.

dos: Do keep the body field as the Abyss Navy → Observatory Slate 135° gradient; new sections inherit it rather than painting their own backgrounds.
Do use glass surfaces (translucent slate fill + cyan hairline + backdrop-blur) for any new floating container, matching the 12px blur / 15%-alpha border defaults.
Do answer interaction with the paired lift + glow (translateY(-2px…-4px) plus a cyan glow from the Shadow Vocabulary), at 300–400ms with cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1).
Do enter new content with slow fade-up reveals (0.5–0.8s, once: true) and 0.1s stagger between siblings.
Do keep ambient motion (orbs, rings, gradient text) confined to designated focal elements — one ambient moment per viewport.
Do keep labels uppercase, 0.75rem, 0.1em tracking, in the cyan family at ≤70% opacity.
Do treat Space Grotesk (--font-display, already loaded) as the sanctioned upgrade path if a distinct display face is ever needed.
donts: Don't ship a light theme or any light-mode variant — dark navy is the identity.
Don't reach for neon-green-on-black terminal/hacker aesthetics; the darkness here is navy water, and the accent is cyan.
Don't introduce hue outside the cyan→teal current and slate neutrals (error red is the single exception).
Don't use white glows or gray/black drop shadows for elevation — glow is always cyan-family.
Don't use pure black (#000000) surfaces anywhere.
Don't spread gradient text across whole paragraphs or multiple words per headline.
Don't hard-radius anything: no 0px corners on UI surfaces, and no radius larger than a capsule for interactive elements.
